    • setTransparency

      void setTransparency(float alpha)
      Set the alpha/transparency of the target. The value should be in the range [0.0, 1.0] with 0.0 being fully opaque and 1.0 fully transparent.

    • getTransparency

      float getTransparency()
      Returns the alpha level of the target. The value will be in the range [0.0, 1.0] with 0.0 being fully opaque and 1.0 fully transparent.
